title: Start with the workflow
body: Understand the user, business goal and operating constraints before choosing a solution. Use AI where it improves the workflow; prefer simpler, deterministic behavior where it does not.

title: Make system boundaries explicit
body: Define clear contracts between applications, services and external dependencies. Set deliberate rules for timeouts, retries, permissions and partial failure instead of relying on happy-path behavior.

title: Test real dependencies and failure modes
body: Combine focused unit tests with integration tests against the systems an application depends on. Exercise conditions such as slow, unavailable or unreliable network connections, and make those checks repeatable in CI.

title: Measure what matters
body: Track the outcomes that matter to users and operators, including task success, reliability, latency and cost. State what has been measured, document limitations, and do not present planned results as proven.
